[LDET.9.16] A runtime that fails a within-platform test is
non-conforming. A runtime whose output on a cross-platform
test is not bit-identical is non-conforming: every
transcendental is correctly rounded ([LDET.3.4.4]), so no tolerance
applies ([LDET.3.4.1]). Per [LCON],
conformance is binary — pass every required test or be
non-conforming, with no partial-conformance levels.
